messages:
jenna-docs: Quick pulse — I'm working on PR #472 for the audit-logs doc. I simplified the retention samples into a single canonical example (TTL + pseudonymize) and updated the JS SDK snippet. Need: 1) compliance wording check for SOC2-friendly phrasing (retention vs purge vs archival), 2) confirm the new snippet uses our recommended export path, 3) the export CLI link in the doc is 404. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/docs/pull/472 :eyes:
omar-security: Thanks, Jenna. Quick guidance: prefer 'retention period' rather than 'automatic purge' in customer-facing SOC2 wording. Also add a short sentence about legal hold overrides (admin approval required). We should explicitly call out pseudonymization of user identifiers in examples. I can mark up the PR with exact phrasing suggestions later today.
sylvia-devrel: I can push a snippet tweak — adding KMS placeholder + an export command example. Do you want the JS snippet to show full payload or just schema?
jenna-docs: Schema-only please. Omar asked to avoid dumping full audit payload in examples. I left a TODO next to the code block in the PR.
mike-eng: Noted on the link — the CLI export page moved. Correct path is https://docs.redwood.ai/cli/export . I can update the link in the PR unless someone else is already on it.
compliance-bot: policy-check: retention-language guideline v2.1 suggests 'retention period' and an explanation of legal hold. See internal policy: https://confluence.redwood.ai/policy/retention. Automated pass pending the legal-hold sentence.
omar-security: Minor nit: in the SDK snippet please redact example_user_id -> <pseudonymized_id> and avoid printing stack traces. Also include a note: 'store keys in customer KMS or Redwood KMS integration only'.
sylvia-devrel: Got it. Will change snippet to show schema + pseudocode and include KMS placeholder: ```js // audit export example
const export = client.audit.export({
  retention: '90d',
  pseudonymize: true,
  keyRef: 'projects/..../kms-key',
});
// payload schema shown, values omitted
``` Pushing change now.
jenna-docs: Awesome — once the patch lands I'll run the doc linter and merge. Can someone add a brief note in the changelog about the TTL wording change (affects customers who copy the sample)?
mike-eng: I'll add a one-liner in the next release notes and link to the updated docs. :thumbsup:
jenna-docs: Thanks everyone. I'll also file a tiny follow-up to add a short FAQ entry about legal holds. Closing after CI passes.
